lead: S. P. Balasubrahmanyam was an Indian playback singer, born on 4 June 1946 in Sri Potti Sri Ramulu Nellore district.
He died on 25 September 2020 in Chennai at the age of 74.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has been recognised with Padma Bhushan and Padma Shri in arts.
This profile collects the S. facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: S. P. Balasubrahmanyam — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: S. P. Balasubrahmanyam was born on 4 June 1946 in Sri Potti Sri Ramulu Nellore district, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Sripati Panditaradhyula Sambamurthy. He is a sibling of S. P. Sailaja.
He received his education at Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University, Anantapur.
He is recorded as speaking Telugu, Tamil, Kannada and Hindi.
